description: Verifies that an XRP Ledger payment settled as expected: validation, result code, destination, destination tag, currency, issuer, and the amount actually delivered, which exposes partial-payment tricks. Useful when confirming that a customer or counterparty really paid. The first call each day returns the real answer without payment. After that, about $0.01 via x402 (USDC on Base, or XRP / RLUSD on the XRP Ledger). A payment watch is paid from the first call. Bad input and ledger outages are never charged.
name: payment_check
title: Payment Check
